argument: The40 certified convex-hull vertices are original source vertices around the origin, with radius at least139999um. Every adjacent angular gap is less thanpi/2 and has sine at most0.234. Thus, after any rotation, some original vertex lies within half that maximum gap of any chosen signed direction. The exact diagonal identity and rational3-4-5 direction bounds certify the listed simultaneous coordinate supports. Flooring the actual cog center changes each signed coordinate by less than1um; subtracting2 gives strict near-edge margins. Every listed corner offset is at least max(0,140003-rectangle-width) in its axis, so the actual vertex also lies strictly before each far edge. Therefore every center in a closed corner box places an actual original vertex strictly inside a source-contained rectangle, giving positive-area source overlap. The hull is used for angular coverage only, never as filled collision geometry. Removed closed cells lie wholly inside one such forbidden box; all remaining legal centers, including boundary sets, stay covered.
